reviews.text: Good hospital, the advantage is that they really attended to the medical situation even though it was already night; it wasn't necessary to admit the dog and they gave us a plan B for him to go to his regular vet the next day. I'm sharing the prices that were published.

Excellent service.
They're open 24/7, and the staff is very humane and professional. I'm so grateful for how they treat our furry friends.
They accept card and cash payments.
They have a snack machine, and water is available for your pet (just ask for the bowl at reception) and for you—both free. The entrance is monitored, and you must register. Exit is only possible with your pet's voucher, which I think is excellent and secure.
The service is excellent! Many thanks to Dr. Karlha Ramirez, soft tissue specialist, for helping Goku with his treatment ❤️

If you have the option of taking your dogs to this hospital, don't.

I took my dog ​​there because she was sent in an emergency from another vet clinic where they didn't have the necessary equipment to treat her. I looked it up online and it seemed like a good place. When I arrived, they told me she had to be admitted and they ran tests, and I trusted them. That day I paid $15,500 for everything they were going to do. Then, the next night, the doctor told me they would have to do more tests for $6,000. Up to that point, there was no actual diagnosis, just speculation. He called me in the morning to say that my dog ​​was better and that they would just do some final tests to make sure her levels were okay, and if so, they could discharge her the next day. Discharged from what? They never gave a diagnosis of what was wrong with her. When I called my vet, he told me that the tests they had been doing had nothing to do with the symptoms she had.

If your dog is sick, don't take it to this place because they'll only make it die. All they care about is making money. I'm going to report them today and I hope they're shut down soon for negligence.
The service was terrible; I only went there to have them order the tests I'd already submitted again. The worst experience ever—900 pesos spent on a consultation.

The care my daughter received (when she was admitted to the emergency room) was very professional, high-quality, and compassionate. Thank you, Dr. Rodrigo, and your entire medical team and receptionists… for your support from beginning to end (God bless you). My daughter was diagnosed accurately, and they always spoke to me truthfully. Unfortunately, my daughter's illness was very advanced due to a misdiagnosis at another veterinary clinic. It was a tragedy not to have known about Delta sooner… otherwise, the story would be very different.
Excellent service, the care is top-notch. Dr. Karla is incredibly professional.

Unfortunately, I didn't read the reviews before taking my dog ​​there. DO NOT TAKE YOUR PETS THERE.
It's a very sad place to put your best friend. They're in tiny cages, all crammed together.
As I read in other reviews, they don't do anything for the animal until you sign the estimate, even if it needs it. If you don't sign and pay, they don't do anything.
The cardiologist didn't provide the proper treatment from the beginning (four months before his death). She didn't prescribe the necessary medication to protect his stomach, which unfortunately caused him to stop eating and start passing blood.
The internist recommended hospitalization, and after three days of no improvement, we asked for him to be taken back.

Even after everything we paid, they asked us IF THE PROBLEM WAS MONEY. Money isn't the problem, but all the money in the world wouldn't make the dog better.

His regular vet, who doesn't work here, saw the tests and told us they were just lying to us about an imaginary "improvement." He never got better, and they just wanted to keep him there to keep charging us.

And please don't reply to me.

Edit: I'm not going to send any emails. I'm very sure the incident happened at your establishment.

***This is just so more people can see the reality of your work.***
Excellent service, all the personalized attention for our kitties
The medicos rotate, there never is a clear explanation. It's always busy and you will pay for things that you don't need, for a service that never ends. Find a smaller veterinarian.
Excellent hospital for our beloved furry friends.
We greatly appreciate your trust and recognition. The entire team at Delta Veterinary Hospital is delighted to care for your little ones. 🐾💙 …

They kept my dog ​​hospitalized for two days. They charged me for x-rays they never took, gave me a diagnosis, and then wanted to do more tests. They charged me for them, but they never did them. Just as I arrived, another woman was complaining about the same thing. BEWARE BECAUSE THEY CHARGE YOU FOR THINGS THEY NEVER DID AND ARE JUST TRYING TO GET MONEY.

Excellent medical service; the doctors answered all my questions, and Robin is very happy coming here. Dr. Eli was very attentive, and the reception staff, Dany and Pia, were incredible. The cleanliness, valet parking, and security were also very good.
I've been calling for days to make a dermatology appointment and they can't even answer, that's terrible.

Excellent care, especially from Dr. Gerardo Pastrana. We arrived with our dog due to a serious emergency, and from the very first moment, he was compassionate, professional, and very clear with us. He explained what was happening, the options we had, and the procedure they would perform, always with great empathy during a very difficult time for our family.

Everything went very well, and we are deeply grateful to him and the entire team. The hospital is very clean, the facilities feel suitable for an emergency, and the staff was attentive at all times, both to our dog and to us.

Special thanks to Dr. Pastrana for his care, clarity, and professionalism. In a situation like this, it makes all the difference to know your pet is in good hands.
Thank you so much for trusting Delta Veterinary Hospital. We will continue working to provide even better care for our patients and their families. 🐾💙 …

A very bad experience. The cost is high for the terrible service they offer. They don't provide timely information and charge you before any procedure, even charging a quote for surgery that, in my case, we already had scheduled, only to find out it was canceled. They never notified us of anything until we went in person because it's impossible to contact them through reception.

The doctors are knowledgeable and kind, but the administration is a disaster. We waited over an hour for a confirmed appointment, then there were no examination rooms available for our dog, so they had to see him in the X-ray room. We kept going in and out because other dogs needed to be seen. The reception staff can't provide information about how much longer the wait will be or explain the delays, and they're incredibly rude, even when taking payments. It's a shame because there are so many good doctors, but I think they're seeing more patients than they can handle.
